title: Soul Man
note: mentioned during Just One of the Guys ep, Bill says Van has been wanting to do Soul Man; mentioned again in Tropic Thunder and Animal House eps as a candidate for Cancelled Month; mentioned again in the summer mailbag ep
plot: A white prospective grad student's affluent family won't pay his way through law school, so he takes tanning pills to darken his skin in order to qualify for an African-American scholarship at Harvard. He soon gets more than he bargained for, as he begins to learn what life is really like for blacks in America.
